summary: Design APIs around stable contracts, explicit semantics, and safe evolution.
intents: design the REST endpoints for an orders service
review our OpenAPI spec before we publish it
will this API change break existing clients
choose error codes and pagination for a public API
plan versioning for a v2 of our API
not_for: implementation of server-side endpoint handlers or backend persistence rather than API contract design
frontend client implementation without API contract decisions
prerequisites: the API's consumers and use cases
service constraints and existing conventions; protocol documentation where relevant

verify.description: The OpenAPI document parses and validates
Version bump matches the breaking-change classification

verify: Every operation documents success and error responses
